intake.method: manual: operator saved individual AAHub mlt pages from a browser to ~/Downloads as "<title> _ AAHub - スマホ対応のアスキーアートビューアー.html"; an extractor (not located in the archive or converter repo) split each saved page into <slug>/<resid>.txt + Saitamaar 16px .png + manifest.txt under ~/Downloads/aahub-consolidated/; tools/build_archive.py copies that directory into collections/aahub/ (sync, sha256).

scripts.role: copy/sync ~/Downloads/aahub-consolidated -> collections/aahub (lines 71, 559-584); no network, no crawling
AA-001..AA-003 intake notes; AA-003 = 173 slugs / 32,950 pairs
records the saved HTML file path in ~/Downloads, never an aahub.org URL

url_types_covered: /mlt/<uniqueKey> pages, only the 172 the operator saved by hand (plus 1 saved home page aahub-index with 0 art)
url_types_not_covered: all other /mlt/<uniqueKey> pages (no crawler; folder tree api/mlt/folders never walked)
intake.no_pagination_issue: an mlt page JSON holds its whole aa[] list; there are no paginated subpages within an mlt

extractor_search.method: grep -rl for 'aa-frame' or 'aahub-consolidated' in *.py/*.js/*.sh under ~/Projects, ~/Downloads, ~/.claude/skills (first 10 hits)
